    private FenTools() {
    }

    static long calculateKeyFromFen(String fen) {

        long piece = calculatePieceFromFen(fen);
        long castle = calculateCastleFromFen(fen);
        long enpassant = calculateEnpassentFromFen(fen);
        long turn = calculateTurnFromFen(fen);
        long key = piece ^ castle ^ enpassant ^ turn;

        return key;
    }

    static long calculatePieceFromFen(String fen) {
        long pieceValue = 0;
        String[] groups = fen.split(" ");
        String[] rows = groups[0].split("/");
        int rowNo = 7;
        for (String row : rows) {
            int fileNo = 0;
            for (int pos = 0; pos < row.length(); ++pos) {
                char c = row.charAt(pos);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    fileNo += Integer.parseInt("" + c);
                } else {
                    int offsetPiece = 64 * kindOfPiece(c) + 8 * rowNo + fileNo;
                    pieceValue = pieceValue ^ random64[offsetPiece];
                    fileNo++;
                }
            }
            rowNo--;
        }
        return pieceValue;

    }

    static int kindOfPiece(char c) {
        final String pieces = "pPnNbBrRqQkK";
        int pos = pieces.indexOf(c);
        if (pos == -1) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown piece " + c);
        }
        return pos;
    }

    static long calculateCastleFromFen(String fen) {
        long castle = 0;

        String[] groups = fen.split(" ");
        String castling = groups[2];

        final char castlingChars[] = {'K', 'Q', 'k', 'q'};
        for (int i = 0; i < castlingChars.length; ++i) {
            if (castling.indexOf(castlingChars[i]) > -1) {
                castle = castle ^ random64[768 + i];
            }
        }

        return castle;
    }

    static long calculateEnpassentFromFen(String fen) {
        long enpassent = 0;

        // String[] groups = fen.split(" ");
        // String enp = groups[3];

        // TODO !!! Missing Implementation

        return enpassent;
    }

    static long calculateTurnFromFen(String fen) {
        String[] groups = fen.split(" ");
        String color = groups[1];

        if (color.equals("w")) {
            return random64[780];
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    }

public interface ChessRules {

    /**
     * Returns the starting position of the game. White begins.
     *
     * @return starting position.
     */
    Position getStartingPosition();

    /**
     * Returns the set of all legal moves for a given position. The current player
     * is determined from the position. In case of a mate or stalemate an empty
     * collection is the result. Thus the method never returns null.
     *
     * @param position game situation to examine
     * @return set of legal moves, empty in case of a mate or stalemate.
     */
    Collection<Move> getLegalMoves(Position position);

    /**
     * Checks whether the king of the given colour is attacked by the opponent.
     *
     * @param position game situation to examine
     * @param colour   side of the king which is tested for an attack
     * @return true in case of check
     */
    boolean isCheck(Position position, Colour colour);

    /**
     * Checks whether the given position is a mate. I.e. the king of the current player
     * is under attack, and no legal move changes this. The player to move has lost the game.
     *
     * @param position game situation to examine
     * @return true in case of a mate
     */
    boolean isCheckmate(Position position);

    /**
     * Checks whether the given position is a stalemate. I.e. the current player has no valid
     * move, but the king is not under attack. The game is considered a draw.
     *
     * @param position game situation to examine
     * @return true in case of a stalemate
     */
    boolean isStalemate(Position position);
}
